title: [GMCP 203.006.06] Operations and evidence: Production-grade Streamable HTTP transport
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-006-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: GMCP serves and consumes current Streamable HTTP over HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with correct POST semantics, media negotiation, streaming and non-streaming responses, origin/host validation, protocol and method headers, cache controls, cancellation, backpressure, connection limits, TLS, proxy awareness, and graceful drain. Removed GET/SSE-resume/session behavior is rejected on the modern path and confined to explicit legacy adapters. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
